source.name: Al-Ittihad – Al-Ittihad Unveils 2026/2027 Home Kit (club announcement)
source.quote: Al-Ittihad Club has officially unveiled its 2026/27 Home Kit
source.note: The launch photos on this page show the Flow logo on the right chest of the home shirt, above the Nike swoosh. The same picture is in the Saudi Pro League's official 2026-27 kit gallery (https://www.spl.com.sa/en/galleries/fresh-fits-kits-of-the-2026-27-rsl).

source.name: TN Media News – Al-Ittihad and TCL Electronics Unite to Inspire Greatness in Saudi Football
source.quote: the TCL logo will feature prominently on the right shoulder of the men's team jerseys and on the upper chest of the women's team jerseys
source.note: Two-season deal signed in October 2025, so it covers 2026/27; the TCL logo also appears on the sleeve in the club's 26/27 home-kit launch photos.

source.name: Al-Ittihad – Al-Ittihad Unveils 2026/2027 Home Kit (club announcement)
source.quote: marking a new chapter in Al-Ittihad's journey while joining the world's leading clubs equipped with the latest Nike Aero-FIT technology
source.note: Kit supplier: the club's launch photos show the Nike swoosh on the shirt, and the club's sponsor footer lists Nike (nike.sa).

summary: Nike home kit. Flow Progressive Logistics on the right chest (front) and TCL on the sleeve; the club's launch photos and shop photos show no back, shorts or patch sponsor for 2026/27.
